components.name: Form
components.use: Settings and data-entry screens: inset-grouped sections of fields, toggles and pickers that are submitted together.
components.avoid: Read-only lists or navigation menus; use List.
components.a11y: Native <form> (named by label) wrapping an inset-grouped List; Return or a submit Button calls onSubmit without a page reload.

components.name: List
components.use: Any vertical collection of rows: insetGrouped for settings and forms, grouped for full-width settings sections, plain for content feeds like mail or contacts.
components.avoid: Grids of media or free-form layouts; use Card.
components.a11y: role=list with labelled sections.

components.name: ListItem

valueAlignment.description: top: message-list row — value (date) on the title line, subtitle full width below, clamped to two lines; with a count badge the subtitle stops at the trailing time/bubble column.

detail.description: Control under the title inside the row (a brightness Slider, input Rating stars).

badge.description: Trailing count bubble: a red filled pill (min 20pt, white 13pt semibold digits) for a number (badge={3}); 0 or empty shows nothing; other text ("Home") stays a plain trailing value. With valueAlignment=top the time sits on the title line and the bubble under it in one end-aligned column; pass 0 on read rows to keep every row aligned.

trailingActions.description: Swipe actions revealed by swiping the row toward the leading side; the first is at the trailing edge.

leadingActions.description: Swipe actions revealed by swiping toward the trailing side; the first is at the leading edge.

swiped.description: Which actions are open; renders the open state statically. The row also opens and closes on swipe.

onSwipeChange.description: Called with the open edge, or undefined when the row closes.

components.use: One row: navigation (chevron), a setting (toggle or value), a single-choice option (checkmark), an in-list action (role), or a content row with swipe actions (delete, flag).
components.avoid: Primary screen actions; use Button outside the list.
components.a11y: role=listitem; interactive rows render a native button; toggles keep the title as their label. Swipe actions are real buttons named by their label: tabbing to one opens the row, Escape closes it.

components.name: ListSection
components.use: Grouping related rows under an optional header and explanatory footer.
components.avoid: A section with a single row and no header; merge it into a neighbouring section.
components.a11y: <section> labelled by its header; error footers are announced (role=alert).

components.name: Screen

topEdgeEffect.description: Scroll-edge effect under the header; hard = opaque blurred bar with a hairline (inline title in a TabView).

onRefresh.description: Pull to refresh (.refreshable): called when the user pulls the content down past the threshold.

refreshing.description: Shows the refresh spinner above the content until set back to false.

refreshLabel.description: Accessible name of the refresh spinner.

tint.description: Tinted wash behind the top of the page that scrolls away.

components.use: The root of every page: it fills the device frame, scrolls the content, applies safe areas, floats the header and bottom bar over the content, and hosts pull to refresh.
components.avoid: Nesting a Screen inside another component or Screen; use one per page and put the NavigationBar in header and the TabBar or Toolbar in bottomBar.
components.a11y: Renders header / main / footer landmarks; the header and bottom bar stay reachable while the main region scrolls. The refresh spinner is a labelled progressbar; pull to refresh is a gesture, so also offer a refresh button where it matters.

components.name: SectionHeader

actionLabel.description: Trailing text button, e.g. See All.

components.use: Title 2 bold heading over a group of cards on a dashboard (summary and store-style card groups), with an optional See All.
components.avoid: Headings inside a List or Form (use ListSection header); more than one heading style on the same screen.
components.a11y: Renders an h2; the action is a separate button named by actionLabel.

components.name: Stack

scroll.description: Horizontal ScrollView: children scroll sideways and snap; use with direction="horizontal".

itemWidth.description: Width of each child in a scrolling stack, in points.

components.use: Spacing and margins around content that isn't a List, such as a segmented control under the navigation bar, a row of buttons or a bottom call to action.
components.avoid: Rows of data; use List with ListItem.
components.a11y: Plain <div>; adds no semantics.

components.name: NavigationBar

onBack.description: Shows the back button. Inside a NavigationStack, pushed pages get it automatically.

items.label: string (i18n, required)
items.menu: MenuItem[] — opens a pull-down Menu from the button (Sort, Add…); onPress is ignored

items.label: string (i18n, required)
items.menu: MenuItem[] — opens a pull-down Menu from the button (Sort, Add…); onPress is ignored

account.description: The signed-in person: an avatar button in a glass circle after the trailing actions.

shape.name: string (i18n, required) — accessible name
shape.initials: string — fallback when there is no photo

components.use: The header of every stack page, in Screen's header slot: large title on root pages, inline title plus back button on pushed pages, up to three glass actions per side.
components.avoid: Switching between top-level sections or putting form controls in the bar; use TabBar for sections and SegmentedControl in the content for filters.
components.a11y: Renders a header with an h1 title; the back button is a native button named by backLabel; icon actions use their label as accessible name; adjacent icon actions merge visually but stay separate buttons.

components.name: NavigationStack

children.description: Root page, usually a Screen with a NavigationBar.

backLabel.description: Accessible name of the automatic back button on pushed pages.

components.use: Drill-down navigation: list → detail → sub-detail. Call useNavigation().push(<Screen…/>) from a row or card; pushed pages get a back button and swipe-from-edge back automatically, with a push/pop transition.
components.avoid: Switching top-level sections (use TabBar) or modal tasks such as create/edit forms (use Sheet).
components.a11y: Only the top page is exposed; covered pages are inert and aria-hidden. Back is a labelled button; the swipe is an extra gesture, never the only way back.

components.name: PageControl
components.use: Showing the position in a horizontally paged carousel or onboarding flow; bare dots over imagery or colour, background=true over plain backgrounds.
components.avoid: More than about ten pages or step-by-step progress (use ProgressView).
components.a11y: A labelled group of dot buttons; the current one has aria-current=page; arrow keys move between pages.

components.name: TabBar

selected.description: Index of the selected item; the search tab is index items.length.

accessory.description: Bottom accessory, e.g. a mini player: 48pt glass capsule above the bar, inline when minimized.

minimizeBehavior.description: onScrollDown collapses the bar to the selected tab and search while Screen's content scrolls down.

minimized.description: Forces the minimized (true) or expanded (false) state.

components.use: Top-level navigation between 2–5 sections of the app, in Screen's bottomBar slot, with an optional search tab, count badges, a persistent accessory such as a mini player, and minimize-on-scroll for long content.
components.avoid: Actions or filters (use Toolbar or SegmentedControl) and more than five sections.
components.a11y: A nav landmark containing a tablist; each tab is a button with role tab and aria-selected; the badge text is part of the tab's name. The accessory is a labelled region; minimized tabs keep their names.

components.name: Button
components.use: Primary and secondary actions: borderedProminent/glassProminent for the one main action, bordered or glass for the rest, large + fullWidth for a bottom call to action.
components.avoid: Navigating to another screen (use ListItem with a chevron) and icon-only actions (use IconButton).
components.a11y: Native <button>; label is the accessible name; aria-busy while loading.

components.name: IconButton
components.use: Circular icon-only actions such as add, share, more or close, including floating glass buttons.
components.avoid: Actions whose icon isn't universally understood; use Button with a label.
components.a11y: Native <button> with aria-label; aria-pressed when selected is set; 44pt hit area.

components.name: Toolbar

items.label: string (i18n, required)
items.menu: MenuItem[] — opens a pull-down Menu from the button (Sort, Add…); onPress is ignored

items.label: string (i18n, required)
items.menu: MenuItem[] — opens a pull-down Menu from the button (Sort, Add…); onPress is ignored

components.use: Page-level actions at the bottom of a pushed or document page (compose, filter, share) with an optional short status such as an item count, in Screen's bottomBar slot.
components.avoid: Navigating between top-level sections, or pages that already have a TabBar.
components.a11y: role toolbar named by label; icon actions are buttons named by their label; status is a live status region.

components.name: Checkbox
components.use: Multi-select or to-do completion outside a List, drawn as a selection circle.
components.avoid: On/off settings (use Toggle) or selecting rows in a List (use ListItem selectable).
components.a11y: Native checkbox input with a label (visually hidden with labelHidden); 44pt hit area; disabled sets aria-disabled.

components.name: DatePicker

value.description: ISO 8601 date-time (e.g. 2026-11-20T10:00:00Z); for mode=countdown an ISO 8601 duration (e.g. PT1H30M)

mode.description: countdown (hours and minutes, max 23 h 59 min) always uses wheels

variant.description: compact pills, inline calendar (graphical; time row for dateTime), or spinning wheels

timeZone.description: IANA time zone for graphical and wheels (device zone by default)

timeLabel.description: graphical + dateTime: label of the time row, e.g. "Time"

components.use: Picking a date and/or time: compact pills in Form rows, graphical when the calendar context matters (booking a day), wheels for precise times or a countdown duration; value is an ISO string.
components.avoid: Free-form or relative dates ("next week"); use a Picker or TextField. Avoid graphical in tight layouts (it needs ~330 × 417pt).
components.a11y: compact: an invisible native date/time input on each pill. graphical: grid of day buttons (arrow keys move by day/week and page months, Enter selects, aria-current=date on today), month steppers and a month/year toggle with aria-expanded. wheels: a spinbutton per column (arrows, Page Up/Down, drag, scroll, tap).

components.name: Picker

options.description: { value: string; label: string; disabled?: boolean }[] — label is visible text

columns.description: wheel only: { label: string; options: PickerOption[]; value: string }[] — several picker components side by side; replaces options/value

onColumnChange.description: wheel with columns: (column: number, value: string) => void

onNavigate.description: navigationLink: the row was tapped; the app pushes the option list

components.use: Choosing one option: menu as a Form row (label, value, chevron), inline as checkmark rows, segmented for 2–5 view modes, wheel for long ordered lists or several linked columns, navigationLink when the options live on a pushed screen.
components.avoid: Navigating to unrelated screens or triggering actions (use ListItem with a chevron or a Button); wheels for fewer than ~5 options (use menu or segmented).
components.a11y: menu: button with aria-haspopup=menu opening menuitemradio items (Escape closes, arrows move); inline and segmented: radiogroup with radios; wheel: one spinbutton per column (arrows, Page Up/Down, Home/End, drag, scroll, tap a row); navigationLink: button.

components.name: SearchField
components.use: Searching or filtering the current page's content; on phones put it in Screen's bottomBar slot.
components.avoid: General text entry or forms; use TextField.
components.a11y: A search landmark with a native type=search input named by label or placeholder; clear, mic and close are buttons named by clearLabel, micLabel and cancelLabel.

components.name: SegmentedControl
components.use: Switching between 2–5 mutually exclusive views or filters of the same content, such as Day / Week / Month.
components.avoid: Top-level navigation (use TabBar) or more than five options (use a Picker or menu).
components.a11y: role radiogroup of role radio buttons with aria-checked; arrow keys move the selection (mirrored in RTL); icon segments are named by their label.

components.name: Slider
components.use: Choosing a value in a continuous or stepped range such as volume or brightness, optionally with min/max symbols.
components.avoid: Exact numeric entry or a handful of discrete counts; use TextField type number or Stepper.
components.a11y: Native range input (invisible, on top of the visuals); label is the accessible name, valueText the spoken value; arrow keys adjust.

components.name: Stepper
components.use: Small increments of a count, like a quantity row "Quantity: 3" with the −/+ control trailing.
components.avoid: Large or continuous ranges; use Slider or a number TextField.
components.a11y: role=spinbutton with aria-valuenow/min/max, labelled by the visible label; arrow, Home and End keys step; the −/+ halves are pointer targets.

components.name: TextField
components.use: Text entry: variant form as a row inside a Form ListSection (visible label = LabeledContent with the value trailing), roundedBorder or plain on their own, and type search for the glass search capsule.
components.avoid: Choosing from a fixed set of values or picking dates; use Picker or DatePicker.
components.a11y: Native <input>/<textarea>; label is the accessible name (visible or aria-label), aria-invalid/aria-required, hint and error linked with aria-describedby.

components.name: Toggle
components.use: Turning a setting on or off immediately.
components.avoid: Choices that need a Save step or more than two options; use Checkbox or Picker.
components.a11y: Native checkbox with role=switch and aria-checked; the label is always present for screen readers.

components.name: Avatar

tone.description: Soft tinted background with initials in the strong tone color (like Media fill=soft). auto picks a stable tone from a hash of name (or initials) so the same person always gets the same color. Omit for the gray Contacts look.

components.use: A person or account: Contacts-style initials on a gray gradient or in a soft tone (tone=auto gives each person a stable color), a photo (a failed image falls back to the initials), or a person symbol when nothing else is known.
components.avoid: App or category icons; use Icon or a ListItem icon tile.
components.a11y: role=img named by name; decorative (hidden) when name is omitted because the name is visible nearby.

components.name: Badge
components.use: A small count or status word next to content (red for notifications, accent for new, gray for neutral counts), or a dot for unread.
components.avoid: Counts at the end of list rows (use ListItem badge) or long text (use Text).
components.a11y: The value is read as text; give label (e.g. "3 unread") for context, and always for dot.

components.name: Card

variant.description: groupBox: plain group box. grouped: white card on a grouped Screen. glass: glass panel.

icon.description: Symbol before the title, sized to the headline line and centred with it.

tint.description: Colour of the title symbol (the title text stays primary). Use a category colour per card, e.g. an orange flame.

onPress.description: Makes the whole card tappable (push a detail page); it scales down slightly while pressed.

components.use: A self-contained block of related content on a grouped page, such as a summary, status or tip; glass for a floating highlight.
components.avoid: Rows of a list or form fields; use ListSection and ListItem.
components.a11y: A <section> labelled by its title heading.

components.name: Chart

height.description: Frame height in points, axis labels included.

area.description: line: fill under the line (AreaMark at 15%).

onSelect.description: Tap or drag across the plot to select a value.

axes.description: full: default axes. minimal: x labels only (highlight cards). none: sparkline.

highlight.description: last: grey bars with the latest tinted (summary cards).

highlightIndex.description: Like highlight last, for the bar at this index: grey bars with that one tinted.

compare.description: line: grey comparison series (last week, average).

formatAxis.description: Formats y-axis ticks (e.g. $2.5K); values use formatValue.

summaryLabel.description: Detail header label (TOTAL, AVERAGE); setting it shows the header, which becomes a callout over the selection.

components.use: Data in dashboards and detail pages: bar / line trends, sparklines (axes none), highlight cards (axes minimal + rule), comparison bars, donut part-of-whole.
components.avoid: Dense or scientific charts, more than ~12 categories, or donuts with more than 5 slices; show a table or list instead.
components.a11y: The SVG is hidden from assistive tech and the data is exposed as a visually hidden table with the chart label as its caption; the selection callout is a polite live region.

components.name: Checklist
components.use: Setup and onboarding progress ("Finish Setting Up"): a handful of steps with a progress bar.
components.avoid: Ordinary to-do lists the user manages (use List with Checkbox rows).
components.a11y: Progress is a labelled progressbar; each step is a button with aria-pressed (or navigates when it has onPress).

components.name: Gauge
components.use: Show a level within a range at a glance, such as battery capacity or a reading on a scale.
components.avoid: Task progress over time; use ProgressView.
components.a11y: role=meter with aria-valuenow 0-100, labelled by label, with currentValueLabel as the value text.

components.name: Glass

variant.description: regular: legible over anything (backdrop brightness compressed, colour kept). clear: nearly untouched backdrop, for glass over photos and video.

tint.description: Glass.tint(_:): regular tint is practically opaque; clear tint lets the backdrop shade the colour.

cornerRadius.description: Corner radius for shape="rect", in points.

interactive.description: Glass.interactive(): swells ×1.2133 on a spring and lights up while pressed.

components.use: Custom floating controls and panels that sit on top of content: a media overlay, a floating action cluster, a custom pill.
components.avoid: Content areas, list rows or full-screen backgrounds (glass is for the control layer above content); stacking glass on glass; re-creating Button, TabBar, Toolbar or SearchField, which already draw their own glass.
components.a11y: A plain container with no role; give interactive content its own button semantics. Text on .clear glass over bright media can drop below AA: prefer .regular behind text.

components.name: Icon
components.use: An icon (built-in or registered name) inline with text; it sizes and baseline-aligns with the current font.
components.avoid: Tappable icons; use IconButton, which provides a 44pt target and a label.
components.a11y: Decorative (aria-hidden) unless label is set; directional symbols mirror in RTL.

components.name: Media

alt.description: Required for meaningful images; omit for decorative ones.

tone.description: Placeholder gradient when there is no src.

fill.description: Icon placeholder fill: soft = tone-tinted surface with a tone glyph (default, for content tiles); vivid = saturated gradient with a white glyph (app icons only).

width.description: Fixed width in points (thumbnails in list rows).

children.description: Overlay pinned to the bottom (a Glass caption, a badge, a progress bar).

components.use: Photos, artwork and video thumbnails in cards, rows and detail headers; gradient placeholders while prototyping.
components.avoid: Icons or symbols on their own (use Icon) and avatars of people (use Avatar).
components.a11y: Pass alt for meaningful images (role img); without alt the image is decorative and hidden. With onPress it becomes a button named by alt.

components.name: NotificationCard

label.description: Small caps header (NOTIFICATIONS); omit for a promo card.

components.use: In-page notices and suggestions on a grouped Screen (e.g. a "Notifications" card): something needs attention, with one action and a close button.
components.avoid: Transient confirmations (use Banner) or blocking decisions (use Alert).
components.a11y: A section with the title as text; action and close are labelled buttons.

components.name: Rating

onChange.description: Makes it an input: tap a star or drag across (Tap to Rate).

components.use: Five-star ratings: showing an average in rows, or letting someone rate (Tap to Rate).
components.avoid: Precise scores or proficiency levels (use Text, Gauge or a Picker).
components.a11y: Display: role img named with the value. Input: role slider (1–5) with arrow keys; dragging is optional.

components.name: RatingSummary

distribution.description: Counts per level, five stars first.

components.use: Ratings summary header: big average, out of 5, 5→1 histogram and the rating count.
components.avoid: Single ratings (use Rating).
components.a11y: One image with an accessible summary (average and count); the bars are decorative.

components.name: StatCard

label.description: Small label above the value (Latest, Average).

caption.description: Top-trailing caption (time of the latest sample).

history.description: Recent values for the mini chart; the last is highlighted.

components.use: KPI / metric tiles on dashboards (summary card style): one number, its unit, recent trend, tap for the detail page.
components.avoid: Long text or several numbers per card; tables of figures (use List with values).
components.a11y: With onPress it is one button whose name reads title, value and unit; the mini chart is decorative (the detail page carries the data).

components.name: Text
components.use: Any standalone text, set in a dynamic-type style (body by default, largeTitle for screen titles).
components.avoid: Text inside other components; pass it to their title/label props instead.
components.a11y: Renders the chosen semantic element; use as="h1"–"h3" for headings.

components.name: Banner
components.use: Confirm a completed action or report a background event without blocking the screen, optionally with one undo-style action.
components.avoid: Decisions the person must make or errors that block the task; use Alert or ErrorState.
components.a11y: role=status (polite) for neutral and success, role=alert (assertive) for warning and danger; the close button needs dismissLabel; Escape dismisses.

components.name: EmptyState
components.use: Fill a screen or list that has no content yet, or no search results, with a short explanation and at most two actions.
components.avoid: Errors and loading; use ErrorState and ProgressView.
components.a11y: Title is a heading; the search variant is a status region so results changes are announced; the icon is decorative.

components.name: ErrorState
components.use: Replace content that failed to load with what went wrong and a retry button.
components.avoid: Validation messages on form fields or transient failures; use the field footer or a Banner.
components.a11y: Wrapped in role=alert so the failure is announced; the retry button shows a spinner and stays labelled while retrying.

components.name: FieldError
components.use: Red validation message, as the section footer under the invalid Form section or inline under a standalone field.
components.avoid: Page-level failures or neutral guidance; use an Alert or Banner, or FieldHint.
components.a11y: role=alert so it is announced when it appears; also set invalid on the TextField.

components.name: FieldHint
components.use: Secondary helper text under a Form section (footer) or directly under a standalone field (inline).
components.avoid: Validation errors; use FieldError.
components.a11y: Plain paragraph; pass id and reference it from the field to have it read with the field.

components.name: ProgressView
components.use: Loading: a circular spinner while waiting, or a linear bar when progress is known.
components.avoid: Placeholder layouts for content still loading; keep the real layout and show a spinner.
components.a11y: role=progressbar with aria-valuenow when determinate; label names it.

components.name: ActionSheet
components.use: Offer a short list of choices about one item (share, duplicate, delete) after the person taps a control.
components.avoid: Navigation or long option lists; use Menu for persistent commands and Sheet for anything with more content.
components.a11y: role=dialog with aria-modal; the cancel action is not drawn (outside tap dismisses) but stays available as a visually hidden button and on Escape.

components.name: Alert
components.use: Ask for confirmation of a consequential action or collect one short value, with two actions side by side or three or more stacked.
components.avoid: Choices that are not a yes/no decision or more than three actions; use ActionSheet, and use Banner for non-blocking feedback.
components.a11y: role=alertdialog with aria-modal, labelled by the title and described by the message; focus moves into the alert and Escape triggers the cancel action.

components.name: ContextMenu

onPress.description: Tap action on the target (open the photo); a long press still opens the menu. Makes the target a button.

components.use: Touch-and-hold shortcuts for a piece of content (photo, card, row): the content lifts as a preview over a dimmed, blurred background with the menu below; also opens on right click and the context-menu key.
components.avoid: The only way to reach an action (it is hidden); keep each command reachable elsewhere and don't use it for primary actions or on controls that already respond to long press.
components.a11y: The target is focusable with aria-haspopup=menu and opens on the ContextMenu key or Shift+F10; the menu takes focus, Escape closes it and returns focus to the target; same item roles as Menu; give the target a label when its content isn't text.

components.name: Menu
components.use: Group secondary commands (sort, filter, view options, more actions) behind a button: titled sections, checkmarks for toggled state, one level of submenus, and a palette row of 3 (medium) or 4 (small) frequent actions.
components.avoid: Primary actions, long lists or deep hierarchies (submenus are one level, about 5 items); use Button, ActionSheet, Sheet or a List screen instead.
components.a11y: role=menu with menuitem / menuitemcheckbox (aria-checked) buttons; submenu items have aria-haspopup and open with Enter or ArrowRight (ArrowLeft/Escape go back); arrow keys move between items and Escape closes; small palette items are labelled by their label prop; destructive items are tinted red and should say what they delete.

components.name: Sheet

onClose.description: Called on a scrim tap, Escape, or a drag down past the dismiss threshold.

detents.description: Detents the user can drag between (.presentationDetents). Default: only `detent`.

onDetentChange.description: Called when a drag settles on another detent.

dismissDisabled.description: .interactiveDismissDisabled(): a drag down snaps back (unsaved changes).

onDismissAttempt.description: Called instead of onClose when dismissDisabled blocks a drag, scrim tap or Escape: show the Discard Changes action sheet here.

components.use: Present a focused task or detail (create, edit, inspect) over the current screen, medium for quick input and large for full forms. Put a NavigationStack inside for pickers that push within the sheet (one path, no modal over modal).
components.avoid: Confirmations and one-line messages; use Alert, and push a new screen for primary navigation.
components.a11y: role=dialog with aria-modal, labelled by the title; header buttons take their accessible names from cancel.label and confirm.label; Escape and scrim tap call onClose. Dragging is a pointer gesture only; keep the cancel button or Escape for keyboard and switch users.
